rules: Verify the destination and avoid duplicate entries before submitting.
Do not certify data redistribution rights, native-client compatibility or support SLAs without separate evidence.
Do not treat source-router and Research Desk tools as the same product.
Use each API's actual CORS and access scope; do not infer a commercial license from a free public endpoint.

products.name: LiquiLens Public Research API
products.pricing_scope: Free public research; private pilots are separately scoped.
products.description: Read-only bank and lender research from public disclosures. Retrieve covered-institution evidence with source links, reporting dates, historical status and missingness. Public research access requires no API key; results support human review and are not credit ratings or investment recommendations.

products.name: Seiche Public Research API
products.pricing_scope: Free public research option; any additional authorized tools remain separate.
products.description: Source-cited research for funding markets, benchmarks, FX and capital-market context. Responses retain observation dates, units, coverage limits and restricted or unavailable states. Public research access requires no API key. Source cadence varies; a successful response is not a freshness guarantee.

products.name: Undertow Market Liquidity API
products.pricing_scope: Free public summary; full-fidelity machine-payable and subscriber tools have separate requirements.
products.description: Read-only market-liquidity research with dated venue evidence and size-specific exit-cost estimates. Public summary access is free; authorization and payment requirements for other surfaces remain explicit. Estimates preserve methodology and coverage limits and are not executable quotes.

products.name: Financial Evidence Research API
products.pricing_scope: Free public research reads; no API key required.
products.description: A read-only REST API for funding reviews, covered institutions, indicative BTC exits and seven research dataset views. An offline task catalog, browser examples and downloadable Postman, Bruno and HTTP clients help you reach a first result. Responses retain source links, dates, units, hashes and unavailable values. Source-specific rights and partial coverage apply; some views report availability only.

products.name: Financial Evidence Research Desk
products.pricing_scope: Free public research reads; no API key required.
products.description: Nine read-only MCP tools for source-cited financial research. Start with a funding review, covered-institution review or indicative BTC exit workflow, then query seven dataset views and source health. Results retain sources, dates, units and unavailable values. Browser, REST and Python examples use the same evidence. This hosted service is distinct from the three-tool Financial Evidence source router.

products.name: Financial Evidence
products.pricing_scope: Free public source routing; no API key required.
products.description: A bounded read-only source router for financial evidence from LiquiLens, Seiche, Undertow and Palimpsest. It preserves product boundaries, source status and provenance and does not combine distinct evidence into a trading score. This is the three-tool source router, separate from the nine-tool Research Desk.

products.name: Palimpsest Public Evidence
products.pricing_scope: Free public research tools; source-specific access and reuse limits remain explicit.
products.description: Explore China economic observations, regional research and the public record through seven read-only MCP tools. Start with the research catalog, inspect coverage and open the cited evidence. Published records retain source dates and unavailable states; document review and source independence remain explicit.

products.name: NarcoScope Evidence Explorer
products.pricing_scope: Free public evidence research; underlying source rights remain separate.
products.description: Explore drug, arms and informal-economy evidence through an interactive atlas, API and fourteen read-only MCP tools. Begin with the market catalog, then inspect dated observations and their sources. Reported figures retain their geography, units and coverage limits.

products.name: NoiseFloor Research Workbench
products.pricing_scope: Open-source local analysis and a public hosted server with synthetic inputs only.
products.description: Inspect whether a change, forecast or correlation survives statistical checks. The browser workbench accepts caller-supplied observations; private datasets belong in the local tools. The ten-tool hosted MCP accepts synthetic inputs only. Examples retain sample size, assumptions, uncertainty and abstention instead of manufacturing a conclusion.
